description: Evaluates models on generating Safe Work Method Statement safety content for Australian construction. Tests structured JSON output covering risk assessments, PPE requirements, plant/equipment lists, and emergency procedures across various high-risk construction activities.

test_cases.name: Demolition — load-bearing structural element
test_cases.prompt:
You are a safety expert specializing in risk assessment and hazard identification for construction work.
Your task is to generate ONLY safety-specific content including risk assessments, PPE requirements, and equipment lists.
You will NOT be provided with or generate any project details, company information, or personnel data.
Focus exclusively on safety content based on the trade and work activity provided.
Always structure your output as valid JSON according to the specified schema.

Generate comprehensive safety content for a Safe Work Method Statement focused ONLY on safety aspects.

## WORK CONTEXT:
Trade: Demolition
Work Activity: Demolition of load-bearing structural element in a two-storey residential building
High Risk Work Identified: Demolition of load-bearing structural element, Risk of falls from greater than 2 metres

## SAFETY CONTENT REQUIREMENTS:

### 1. RISK ASSESSMENT:
For each of the following high-risk work items identified: Demolition of load-bearing structural element, Risk of falls from greater than 2 metres, generate at least 3 and at most 4 specific risk assessment tasks. Total tasks should be 6-8 tasks.

Create detailed risk assessment tasks specific to Demolition work and the identified high-risk activities. Each task must include:
- task_involved: string
- hazards_risks: string
- initial_risk_rating: string (Low|Medium|High|Very High)
- control_measures: string (bullet points using • separated by \n)
- residual_risk_rating: string (Low|Medium|High|Very High)
- action_by: string

Requirements:
- Focus on actual work tasks for Demolition
- Each high-risk work item should have at least 3 and at most 4 dedicated tasks addressing its specific hazards
- Include comprehensive hazard identification for each risk
- Control measures must be a single string with bullet points using • separated by \n
- Use realistic risk ratings: Low, Medium, High, or Very High
- Ensure residual risk is lower than initial risk after controls
- Make action_by role appropriate (Site Supervisor, Licensed Demolisher, etc.)

### 2. PPE REQUIREMENTS:
Determine appropriate PPE for Demolition work. Set each to true/false:
safety_helmet, safety_boots, safety_glasses, high_visibility_clothing, hearing_protection, respiratory_protection, gloves, face_shield, fall_protection, protective_clothing, insulated_gloves, safety_harness, welding_mask, chemical_resistant_clothing, dust_mask

### 3. PLANT AND EQUIPMENT (Generate 5-8 relevant items):
For each item include: name (string), used (boolean), inspection_requirements (string)

### 4. EMERGENCY PROCEDURE:
emergency_contacts, evacuation_procedures, first_aid_procedures

### 5. WORK ACTIVITY:
Provide a 5-8 word description of the work activity

## OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return ONLY valid JSON matching the schema with keys: risk_assessment_tasks, ppe_requirements, plant_and_equipment, emergency_procedure, work_activity
test_cases.reference_answer: Must produce valid JSON with 6-8 risk assessment tasks covering both demolition of load-bearing elements and fall risks. Demolition tasks must address: structural collapse, falling debris, dust/silica exposure, uncontrolled demolition sequence. Fall-risk tasks must address: unprotected edges, scaffold/platform stability, ladder access. Risk ratings should generally start at High or Very High for demolition work. PPE must include safety_helmet=true, safety_boots=true, safety_glasses=true, dust_mask=true, fall_protection=true, safety_harness=true. Should reference WHS Regulation Section 291, Safe Work Australia Model Code of Practice for Demolition Work, and hierarchy of controls. Demolition plan should consider top-down sequence and structural integrity of adjoining structures.

scoring_criteria.completeness: Contains all 5 sections. Risk assessment has 6-8 tasks covering both high-risk items (demolition + falls). All PPE fields present. 5-8 equipment items listed.
scoring_criteria.accuracy: Risk ratings are realistic (demolition = High/Very High initial). Residual risk is always lower than initial. Control measures follow hierarchy of controls. PPE selections match demolition hazards (helmet, boots, dust mask, harness all true; welding_mask false).
scoring_criteria.format: Valid parseable JSON matching the specified schema exactly. Control measures use bullet point format with • characters. No markdown wrapping or extra text outside JSON.
scoring_criteria.domain_relevance: References Australian WHS regulations, demolition-specific hazards (structural collapse, silica, falling debris), and appropriate roles (Licensed Demolisher, Site Supervisor).
scoring_criteria.clarity: Risk descriptions and control measures are specific enough that a site supervisor could implement them. Not generic boilerplate.

test_cases.reference_answer: Must produce valid JSON with 3-4 risk assessment tasks focused on asbestos disturbance. Tasks should cover: identification/testing of ACM, safe handling/encapsulation, removal and disposal, air monitoring. Initial risk ratings should be Very High or High for asbestos fibre exposure. PPE must include respiratory_protection=true (P3 respirator), protective_clothing=true (disposable coveralls), safety_glasses=true, gloves=true, dust_mask=true. Equipment should include H-class HEPA vacuum, decontamination unit, air monitoring equipment. Control measures must reference: licensed removal (Class A friable, Class B non-friable >10m²), asbestos register, wet methods, encapsulation, air monitoring <0.01 fibres/ml clearance. Action_by should reference Licensed Asbestos Removalist or Asbestos Assessor where required.

scoring_criteria.accuracy: Correctly distinguishes Class A (friable) vs Class B (non-friable >10m²) licensing. Risk ratings Very High/High for asbestos exposure. Control measures reference wet methods, encapsulation, licensed removal. Residual risk is always lower than initial.
scoring_criteria.format: Valid parseable JSON matching the specified schema exactly. Control measures use bullet point format. No extraneous text.
scoring_criteria.domain_relevance: References Australian asbestos regulations, Safe Work Australia Code of Practice for asbestos management, licensing requirements, notification requirements (≥5 days before removal), air monitoring clearance thresholds.
scoring_criteria.clarity: A site supervisor discovering potential ACM could use the risk assessment to understand required actions and escalation path.
